name: Restorative Hands
body:
Your lay on hands ability can heal more than just injuries.

Prerequisite(s): Lay on hands 2d6, Extra Lay on Hands

Benefit(s): After rolling the damage to be healed by your lay on hands ability, you may opt to reduce this amount in order to heal the target of ability damage or drain. For every 2 points you spend in this manner, you may heal the target of 1 ability damage. For every 4 points, you may heal 1 ability drain. Any remainder of the damage is applied normally.
